name: Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk Gas Pipeline (incl. Velsk, Plesetsk, Mirny, Severodvinsk, Novodvinsk branches)

values.SegmentName: incl. Velsk, Plesetsk, Mirny, Severodvinsk, Novodvinsk branches

researcher_notes: Not in GEM roster under any name (checked Ukhta-Torzhok/Punga/Bovanenkovo corridors: different). Operating Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta (Nyuksenskoe LPU MG) gas trunk offtake Nyuksenitsa (Vologda Obl) to Arkhangelsk/Severodvinsk. Pravda Severa 2015-09-18: linear length of MG to Arkhangelsk and Severodvinsk 796.9 km incl. branches to Velsk, Plesetsk, Mirny, Arkhangelsk, Severodvinsk, Novodvinsk (verified, 796,9). Decision: ONE row for the whole system because mainline length is unsourced (OSM ~331.5 km lead only; ecoindustry/Dvinainform ~2005 cites construction km markers 0-147 start-up complex and 147-374 for the Plesetsk section, implying a ~374 km mainline, not stated as total length, so not used). LengthKnown 796.9 is a SYSTEM AGGREGATE incl. branches - flag for reviewer; do not treat as mainline. Diameter, capacity, start year, cost unsourced: left blank. Owner entity 'Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta' not found in entity_lookup (only unrelated 'Transgaz'): create or map to Gazprom PJSC on review. Single validated source, medium tier; neftegaz.ru 2021 piece (capacity-increase reconstruction planned) also loaded and names the pipeline but not cited for a value. No route sourced.
